GTA V radio station icon notice
================================

The radio station names, logos, branding, and game artwork in
web/public/radio-icons are owned by Rockstar Games, Take-Two Interactive,
and/or their respective rights holders. They are included for identification
inside a Grand Theft Auto V / FiveM modification. cortex-hud is not affiliated
with or endorsed by Rockstar Games or Take-Two Interactive.
